last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: CAMPAIGN — Ask-Machine Week WON and CLOSED Fri 07-24, victory lap fired clean. Fri 07-24 (afternoon, ANDREW-INITIATED — he brought the words): overheard 'prachanai' and 'kitta' off HIS WIFE AND HER SISTER talking to each other, full speed, unaimed at him, and carried both home. First real-world catch evidence in the system — the eavesdrop axis moved outside the lab. Ran as a meta/lore day on his two words and cleared the lot: KITTA cold (akka-kitta ketten, novel slot), KETKUREN cold (naan maama-kitta ketkuren — the present/future toggle that was a listed gap), then the exit scene in one unbroken breath: AVASARAM IRUKKU cold, STATION-KKU POGANUM cold, KEYS EN-KITTA KUDUNGA cold (kudunga victory lap with kitta bolted on). BOTH 07-22 STRAGGLERS CLOSED. Taught: kel = ask AND hear, one verb, and kitta is the switch (person in the sentence -> asked; thing -> heard); en/un as the lying-down stems he already owned via enakku/enga/unakku; the vanishing object — Tamil deletes what context carries — which HE found himself. One recast: drop redundant 'naan', the -en tail already says I (same deletion law, second sighting). TESTIMONY, twice, unprompted: 'overwhelms me a bit and also makes me feel like I am actually making progress — my theory of limited lemmas and picking up context is starting to pay off', and the big one: 'it feels more intuitive straight in tamil and not thinking about how the sentence is translated — not cumbersome natively but challenging to translate.' That is the deer-in-headlights antidote in his own words. KEEP DENSITY LOW while this holds — he named overwhelm in the same breath as progress. FIELD MISSION 07-24: 'en-kitta kudunga' at the dinner table tonight (guaranteed slot — something always needs passing), plus a standing CATCH order: bring back one word overheard from the sisters. NEXT CAMPAIGN PITCHED, NOT YET AGREED — The Overhear Week: catch is the starving axis (0/12) and he just proved catch works in the wild; quote-nu, hearsay-aam, youknow-la, ennamo prachanai, alaichal as catch targets, the kel/kitta family riding as fire. Andrew adjusts it at the next open. -aam watch still open at 3 misses.
